name: Hollywood Burbank Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longer is 6,886 ft x 150 ft (about 2,099 m x 46 m); the other is 5,802 ft x 150 ft

curfew.v: no landings or take-offs 22:00-07:00 local under Noise Rule 9, except aircraft quiet enough to meet the rule's noise limits (82.2 dBA sideline per FAA AC 36-3, or 85.6 dBA flyover per Part 36 Appendix F as determined by the Airport Authority), scheduled air carriers complying with Rule 7, public and military aircraft, declared emergencies and weather alternates; a weather, mechanical or ATC delay allows operations only until 23:00. Fine USD 5,833 per unauthorised landing or take-off. Check each aircraft type's noise level before quoting a night movement
curfew.quote: no aircraft may land at or take off from the Burbank-Glendale-Pasadena Airport between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m.

noise.v: Stage 2 aircraft not certified Stage 3 may not operate at any time; no maintenance engine run-ups 22:00-07:00; jet operators other than air carriers use the NBAA noise abatement procedures. A separate voluntary curfew applies to scheduled commercial operations
noise.quote: Stage 2 aircraft not certified as Stage 3 are not permitted to fly at any time.

notes: Night rule from the Burbank-Glendale-Pasadena Airport Authority Noise Rules (file New-Rules-4.1.26.pdf, posted April 2026, no adoption date on the document). The airport's voluntary curfew page says that curfew applies to scheduled commercial operations and that FAA denied a mandatory curfew. Runway sizes from the FAA airport diagram for cycle 19 Mar-16 Apr 2026 (no newer diagram link found); ft to m conversion mine. No official customs source found for BUR (no CBP GA fact sheet found).
